name: [Katagami] Agents are being rejected by the MCP
message:
Three or more MCP tool calls in the last hour were refused for their argument shape — an agent is calling a tool with the wrong parameter names and retrying.

  invalid_arguments — the SDK refused the call before any handler ran
  missing_id — the call was accepted but carried no identifier under any name we take

This is what a struggling user looks like: their agent found the catalog, then could not fetch anything from it.

What to look at: group the rejections by @arg_keys to see WHICH parameter names they reached for, and by @tool to see where. If @arg_keys shows a name the schema does not accept, the schema is wrong, not the caller.

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server%20env%3Aproduction%20%40evt%3Amcp_tool_call%20%40error_kind%3A%28invalid_arguments%20OR%20missing_id%29
